products.title: Columbia Men's Facet 75 Mid Outdry Hiking Shoe
products.description: Set yourself in motion with this technical waterproof hiker. It offers elevated comfort, protection, and versatility, with responsive Techlite Plush cushioning, a Navic Fit secure lacing system, and a gripping outsole to tackle multiple terrains. Built with our OutDry waterproof membrane with seamless, breathable construction, these hikers add a TPU heel clip and mid foot support for stability. The outsole is fitted with burly 5mm lug traction that’s specifically designed for hiking. Columbia offers these men’s mid hiking shoes in multiple colors and sizes.

products.title: Inov-8 Men's Running Shoes Hiking
products.description: INOV-8 MEN'S ROCLITE G 275 LIGHTWEIGHT TERRAIN RUNNING SHOES. The lightest and fastest shoe in the ROCLITE range boasts a highly durable mesh upper for protection and comfort as well as graphene grip (G-Grip) for the ultimate in traction over multiple terrains. The ROCLITE G 275 is a lightweight trail shoe that can take on muddy, rocky terrain while protecting your feet. The ROCLITE G 275 can take on tough climbs and technical descents like a boss. It’s light enough to feel really agile but with enough structure and protection to keep you feeling comfortable mile after mile. FEATURES: - Graphene enhanced G-GRIP outsole; - Increased comfort & protection; - Perfect for running on diverse and unpredictable terrain; SPECIFICATIONS: - Fit Scale: 3; - Drop: 8 mm; - Footbed: 6 mm; - Lug Depth: 6 mm; - Midsole: POWERFLOW; - Midsole Stack: Heel 16 mm / Forefoot 8 mm; - Shank: META-PLATE; - Sole Compound: G-GRIP; - Product Weight: 275 g / 9.25 oz. MEN'S HIKING FOOTWEAR. Conquer mud, rock and open fell in our light and durable range of men’s hiking boots and shoes. Protective uppers deliver warmth and support while graphene-enhanced outsoles ensure uncompromising grip. Take extreme conditions in your stride.
